title: Curriculum-Based Noise Adaptation for Phoneme-to-Text Reconstruction in Visual Speech Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2609.20839v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Phoneme-centric visual speech recognition reconstructs sentences from intermediate phoneme predictions, making overall recognition performance highly dependent on the robustness of the phoneme-to-text reconstruction model. Existing reconstruction approaches are commonly trained on clean phoneme sequences or synthetically corrupted inputs, leading to a mismatch between training conditions and the realistic phoneme prediction errors encountered during inference. To address this limitation, this paper proposes progressive error curriculum training (PECT). This curriculum learning framework progressively adapts a No Language Left Behind (NLLB)-based phoneme-to-text reconstruction model using synthetic phoneme perturbations, multi-domain pseudo-labels, and target-domain pseudo-labels generated by a visual speech recognizer. translated_title: 视觉语音识别中基于课程学习的噪声自适应音素到文本重建
translated_abstract: 以音素为中心的视觉语音识别通过中间音素预测来重建句子，因此整体识别性能高度依赖于音素到文本重建模型的鲁棒性。现有的重建方法通常在干净的音素序列或合成损坏的输入上进行训练，导致训练条件与推理阶段遇到的真实音素预测错误之间存在不匹配。为解决这一局限，本文提出了渐进式错误课程训练（PECT）。该课程学习框架利用合成音素扰动、多领域伪标签以及由视觉语音识别器生成的目标领域伪标签，逐步对基于 NLLB（No Language Left Behind）的音素到文本重建模型进行自适应调整。通过让重建模型逐渐接触到越来越真实的音素预测错误，所提出的框架……
tldr: 本文提出渐进式错误课程训练（PECT），通过课程学习让音素到文本重建模型逐步适应从合成扰动到真实推理错误的各种音素噪声，从而提升视觉语音识别的整体性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Progressive Error Curriculum Training (PECT), a curriculum learning framework that progressively adapts an NLLB-based phoneme-to-text reconstruction model to increasingly realistic phoneme prediction errors, improving robustness in visual speech recognition.
